shortDescription: Yes Bank Ltd. asked India's top court to review a ruling that revived 84.2 billion rupees ($893 million) of bonds written off during its 2020 rescue. The lender has said the decision could reduce a key capital ratio by about 2.5 percentage points, Bloomberg reported.
